issue.title: Migrating an archdraw/diagram@1 file cuts long tech lines and zone names without any warning
issue.body:
I ran `archdrawer migrate` on an old `archdraw/diagram@1` file. A component's `tech` text (80 characters) and a zone label (65 characters) were cut to 60 and 48 characters with an ellipsis, but the command printed no warning about either. The drawing contract for reading @1 says over-long text is shortened and that every change other than a plain rename adds one warning. Long component labels and connection labels do get a warning.

Reproduction file `v1-long.archdraw.json`:
```json
{ "schema": "archdraw/diagram@1", "id": "d_v1sample01", "title": "Shop", "subtitle": "How an order flows",
  "nodes": [{ "id": "api", "label": "API", "kind": "service", "tech": "Node.js 20 with Express, Zod validation, Prisma ORM and a Redis cache layer", "description": "Takes orders", "group": "backend", "files": [], "x": 40, "y": 80 }],
  "groups": [{ "id": "backend", "label": "Backend services running in the primary AWS region (eu-central-1)", "parent": null, "x": 20, "y": 20, "w": 300, "h": 200 }],
  "edges": [], "notes": [] }
```
`archdrawer migrate v1-long.archdraw.json` prints:
```
Zone "backend" became a group component
Converted from archdraw/diagram@2
migrated
```
The written file has `backend` label `"Backend services running in the primary AWS reg…"` and `api` sub `"Node.js 20 with Express, Zod validation, Prisma ORM and a R…"`. An over-long title, subtitle or note text is also cut without a warning.

expected.cause: migrateV1 in src/core/migrate.ts applies `clip` to the title, group labels, `tech`, the subtitle and note texts without pushing a warning, unlike its component-label and connection-label branches.

notes: {"origin": "M5 real use: a genuine defect found in ArchDrawer at this commit and reproduced; replayed, not filed", "proof": "tsx p6.mts -> 'Zone \"backend\" became a group component' / 'Converted from archdraw/diagram@2' / 'migrated' / 'exit 0' / 'backend label: \"Backend services running in the primary AWS reg…\" sub: \"\"' / 'api label: \"API\" sub: \"Node.js 20 with Express, Zod validation, Prisma ORM and a R…\"'"}
